Executive Overview

The catalog shows broadly healthy satisfaction: average rating is 4.10, and 75.8% of products are rated at least 4.0. Promotional intensity is high, with an average discount of 47.7% and a median discount of 50.0%.

Pricing headline: deeper discounts do not translate into higher satisfaction in this dataset. The discount-to-rating correlation is -0.155 (weak negative), while discount-to-review-volume correlation is 0.012 (near-zero).

Top category by rating

Office Products leads major categories with an average rating of 4.31 across 31 products.

Largest category

Electronics contains 526 products, the largest share of the catalog.

Engagement baseline

The median product has 5,179 customer ratings; total rating counts sum to 26,766,377.

Pricing & Discount Strategy Analysis

Correlation summary

Discount % → rating: -0.155 Discount % → rating count: 0.012 Actual price → rating: 0.122 Discounted price → rating: 0.120 Actual price → rating count: -0.036

The strongest pricing takeaway is directional rather than promotional: discounts have a weak negative relationship with rating and a near-zero relationship with review volume. Average list price is ₹5,445, average selling price is ₹3,125, and average rupee savings is ₹2,320.

Strategic Recommendations

  1. Stop using deeper discounts as the default quality lever. Discount percentage has a -0.155 correlation with rating and only 0.012 with rating count, so broad discount escalation risks margin erosion without clear satisfaction gains.
  2. Prioritize quality and assortment intervention in weaker major categories. Home & Kitchen averages 4.04 stars versus 4.31 for Office Products; category teams should review low-rated SKUs, claims, and supplier quality.
  3. Use high-engagement sub-categories as merchandising anchors. Accessories has the highest median rating count among sizable sub-categories at 67,260, making it a strong candidate for traffic-driving placement and cross-sell bundles.
  4. Plan promotions by segment, not by blanket depth. The best-rated price segment is ₹5,000+ with 4.17 stars, while the best-rated discount band is <20%; promo guidelines should reflect segment response rather than one universal discount target.
  5. Address review pain points in product detail pages and supplier scorecards. Negative review keywords most often mention quality issues (1,981 mentions), while positive mentions cluster around performance (5,674 mentions).

Methodology & Data Quality

  • Parsed rupee and percentage strings into numeric fields; malformed rating values were converted to missing values.
  • Top-level and sub-level categories were extracted from the pipe-delimited category path.
  • Correlation metrics use Pearson correlation on rows with valid values for both variables.
  • Category rankings exclude categories with fewer than 10 products when identifying major-category winners and risks.
  • Review sentiment snapshot is keyword-count based and should be treated as directional qualitative evidence.
